analysis.title: Multi-Asset Strategy Daily
key_insights: Yesterday's CPI beat shifted the Fed debate toward how quickly it tightens rather than whether and when. Core CPI printed 0.3% MoM with deteriorating breadth, and the read-across to core PCE points to another firm 0.35-0.40% print.

With Waller opening the door to 50bp, the market pushed December pricing to ~28bp and close to three hikes by mid-2027. The reaction was an aggressive bear-flattening, with 2Y UST yields briefly at 4.75% and 10Y through 4.9% ahead of a slightly soft auction.
Mizuho sees 25bp in December and January as easier to justify than an immediate 50bp, but says CPI raised the bar for fading front-end weakness.
Focus ahead of Friday's PPI is whether Fed speakers validate the market's more aggressive pricing. Goolsbee called CPI 'borderline disturbing' while Paulson still favours gradual tightening.

Brent tested $90 yesterday on US-Iran diplomacy hopes and Trump signalling further strikes were unlikely for now, then partially reversed to about $92 this morning. A renewed rise in crude would make the Fed's inflation problem harder to ignore.
EGBs outperformed the UST sell-off. German 2Y yields rose about 8bp and 10Y about 4-5bp, versus a near-20bp jump in UST 2Y. EUR/USD fell below 1.1160.

With around 63bp of ECB tightening priced through next September, Mizuho thinks another sizeable front-end sell-off in EUR rates needs a change in ECB rhetoric. EUR rates should keep a lower beta to the Fed repricing unless ECB speakers turn hawkish.
Gilts reversed early gains. The 10Y yield moved from about 5.10% to above 5.20% after Lombardelli's hawkish comments and strong US CPI. GBP/USD gave back the week's gains to about 1.3340.

Mizuho is reluctant to fade UK front-end weakness aggressively given NIESR sees inflation above target until 2030, but expects the BoE to deliver fewer hikes than the ~80bp priced into H2-27. December is about 17bp priced.
Asian risk sentiment held up on AI optimism. JGBs sold off, led by the 7-10Y area, and USD/JPY rose sharply to about 158.90.
